instruction: Turn towards a large wooden manel, go forward through a doorway and continue down a red carpet between rope barriers until you reach the next doorway, facing a large bed,and stop.

steps.thought: I see the red carpet leading straight to a doorway ahead. I'll advance along the carpet toward it.
I'm facing the doorway at the end of the red carpet; continue forward along the carpet toward it.
I'm aligned with the red carpet leading to the doorway ahead. Continue forward along the carpet.
I'm aligned with the doorway ahead; continue along the red carpet through it.
I've passed through the first doorway and am on the red carpet. I'll continue forward along the carpet toward the next doorway.
I'm on the red carpet between rope barriers, heading toward the next doorway ahead. I'll advance a few steps and re-observe.
I'm on the red carpet between rope barriers in an octagonal room. The next doorway (facing a bed) appears to be the dark opening on the left, so I'll advance along the carpet and then aim for it.
I'm on the red carpet between rope barriers. The next doorway appears to be the opening on the left leading to a lit room; I'll turn toward it and advance.
I'm on the red carpet facing the next doorway; through it a room with a large bed is visible. I'll advance through the doorway and stop near it.
I've passed through the doorway and the red carpet leads ahead into a room where a large bed is visible. I'll advance a couple of steps along the carpet toward the bed, then stop.
